title: Pressing their defender
text: Their defender has the ball near their own goal. You're the closest player.
tip: Press with your body angled to block the pass you don't want them to make.

options.text: Sprint straight at them to rush them
options.why: Puts them under pressure, but they can simply pass round you.

options.text: Stand still and wait for a mistake
options.why: It gives them time to pick the perfect pass.

options.text: Curve your run to block the easy pass
options.why: A curved run cuts off one option, pushing them towards your teammates or a long hopeful kick.
